{"notes": "VISIT 1 (ended 1:00). I don't know who placed which domino, so I'm not crediting any build to a person. Only hands positions and what people said.

Board: one connected run from the start (nose, left) splitting into a long upper branch (ending near x=12, Sofia's hands there) and a short lower branch (ending near x=6, Omar's hands there). A separate pale, unconnected cluster sits far right near x=22-26 (tail area). It looks like an upper-fin stroke plus a short horizontal piece. I don't know who placed it. The gap from the connected run is large, so it needs bridging. Ask the team who started it.

Sofia: Silent on my visit. Her hands were at the tip of the long upper branch, which is the most progressed part of the build. Execution looks steady, but I can't attribute it. Need to hear from her on visit 2.

Omar: Silent. His hands were at the short lower branch, which is behind the upper one. Check whether he's blocked or just started. Need more evidence.

Hana: Gave a clear plan (fish facing left, one run from the nose splitting over top and bottom and meeting at the tail). She caught Jack's direction error politely and offered to take the lower fin after finishing the nose. Strong collaboration and leadership so far. I haven't seen her place anything. Don't overrate on talk alone.

Jack: Said 'fish is going well' and called what he was laying the lower tail fin. It was actually the upper fin (stroke 4). He took the correction well and kept going. His status update was vague and he was mistaken on which fin. Fine so far, but check he stays on the right stroke.

To do next visit: ask Sofia and Omar directly, check the tail gap is bridged, and check whether the two branches meet."}
